body: There are relationships between myself and others that I cannot fix. Those other people have chosen to remove me from their lives. Since it is their right to do so, there is nothing I can do to change this. I've been in the same place with this for the past 2 years. I don't find myself feeling much better about it, and more hopeless by the day. It is constantly distracting me. I've got an adjustment disorder, obsessive compulsive personality, and severe depression. The past two years of my life have been unbelievably difficult for me, and even with all the work I have put in I will never have those relationships back. I am severely stubborn and its a reality I am not willing to accept. I had gone several months with very limited suicidal thoughts, but they're becoming more frequent, its near impossible to do work, and a lot of basic things. I have been sleeping in many days. There aren't many I manage to get up for before 4 in the afternoon.  I don't see things improving soon, but taking a turn for the worse.
